items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I worked with Henry Rush with Kit Thomas... So that's when I started playing with them. They always called him Kit Thomas.

ctx.x: Yeah, well that's another guy. Yeah. And I worked with Henry Rush with Kit Thomas. Oh yeah? Yeah.
When were you working with Thomas? That was way early in your career? Yeah, it was kind of early in my career. You never worked in his band in later years?

No. You see, well, Kit Thomas and the guy they called Elton, well I didn't know this until afterwards. It was Kit Thomas' band, but Elton was running the band. You see, we all started with Elton's band until they had some kind of misunderstanding, and they split. So he had to change the name from Kit Thomas to another name, you see. So that's when I started playing with them. They always called him Kit Thomas.

items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I know where he used to live. Would he be under T or Kid?

ctx.x: Nobody knew him about Valentine. No. I didn't know that either, as long as I didn't know any more of my days. I didn't know his children saw Valentine until then.
Well how would you look up Kid Twat in the phone book?
Well, I don't know his telephone number. I know where he used to live. Would he be under T or Kid?
